== Church or NonProfit ==
Continuation of [[October 25, 2010: Online Work Bee#Church or NonProfit|discussion from last time]]

* Ben would be fine with having a church as long as I was allowed to be qualificationalist enough about it. 
** Third example of this: Because we believe in wiki principles, this will not become an ossified institution [...]
** Can we think of a word other than "religion" to avoid having to keep mentioning all those caveats?
* Names
** SolSeed is a bad choice because you're part of "the body of all life on Earth" whether you like it or not
** Church/Seeds of Gaia would be good names in that a lot of people would recognize the Gaia concept
* A church can make it difficult for us to get respect for our other organizations ... tainting our businesses and nonprofits
** We would be focusing even more on depth ... support people who want to make this their way of life, rather than just resonating with the epic story
* Can we just found a religion for the three of us, and then decide whether it's central to the [[SolSeed Movement]]?
** Keep it sort of secret for awhile so it doesn't freak anyone else out?
** We could at least look at our answers to the IRS questions for designation as a religion ... might help clarify our thought process
